Common questions

You Might Be Wondering…

Do I need a big ad budget?

No. This system is designed to work with $20–$30/day. The goal is to understand the structure first, then scale when you see results.

Do I need to be tech-savvy?

No. The campaign setup section walks through every step with plain language explanations of what to click and why. If you can use Instagram, you can do this.

What if I don't have professional videos?

You don't need them. The guide specifically explains how to film high-converting content with just your phone and natural light. Authenticity outperforms production value in beauty ads.

Is this just for Meta / Instagram?

Yes, the campaign setup section focuses on Meta (Facebook and Instagram), which is where the majority of beauty service bookings come from for local providers.

What if I've tried ads before and it didn't work?

That's actually why this guide exists. Most failed attempts come from weak creative, wrong objectives, or no clear DM strategy. This system addresses all three.

How quickly will I see results?

Results depend on execution, offer, and location. Some clients see DM inquiries within days. The system asks for at least 5–7 days before drawing conclusions and 30 days to see meaningful patterns.
